#!/usr/bin/env python3
import csv
import zipfile
import pandas as pd

# Paths
STOP_DETS_CSV = "outputs/t05_clean_stops.csv"
STOP_TIMES_CSV = "outputs/t05_clean_stop_times.csv"
GTFS_ZIP = "inputs/gtfs/sample_city_gtfs.zip"
OUT_CSV = "outputs/t06_stop_service_intensity.csv"

# Read cleaned stops
stops_df = pd.read_csv(STOP_DETS_CSV)

# Read cleaned stop times
stop_times_df = pd.read_csv(STOP_TIMES_CSV)

# Read trips.txt from the GTFS zip
with zipfile.ZipFile(GTFS_ZIP) as z:
    trips_df = pd.read_csv(z.open("trips.txt"))

# Merge stop times with trips to get route_id
merged_df = stop_times_df.merge(trips_df[[ "trip_id", "route_id"]], on="trip_id", how="left")

# Aggregate service intensity attributes per stop
agg_df = merged_df.groupby("stop_id").agg(
    n_departures=("stop_id", "count"),
    n_routes=("route_id", pd.Series.nunique),
    first_departure=("departure_time", "min"),
    last_departure=("departure_time", "max")
).reset_index()

# Merge with original stops to keep all cleaned stops
service_df = stops_df.merge(agg_df, on="stop_id", how="left")

# Replace missing values (in case a stop has no service)
service_df["n_departures"] = service_df["n_departures"].fillna(0).astype(int)
service_df["n_routes"] = service_df["n_routes"].fillna(0).astype(int)
service_df["first_departure"] = service_df["first_departure"].fillna("")
service_df["last_departure"] = service_df["last_departure"].fillna("")

# Reorder columns to required output order
service_df = service_df[[
    "stop_id",
    "stop_name",
    "stop_lat",
    "stop_lon",
    "n_departures",
    "n_routes",
    "first_departure",
    "last_departure",
]]

# Write out as RFC4180 compliant CSV
service_df.to_csv(
    OUT_CSV,
    index=False,
    quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL
)
</solution_file>
